answer_3.quote: Using both open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs), we develop 'proxy annotators' that complete the tasks comparably to an arbitrary human annotator; we call the method PROXANN.

answer_4.quote: We recruit at least four annotators per topic through Prolific.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to: (1) identify the category by providing a free-text label; (2) judge the relevance of each evaluation document to the inferred category on a 5-point scale; (3) rank the evaluation documents by their representativeness for the category.
